title: Invasive species（机经听写）
titleCn: 雅思听力Part4入侵物种机经：金雀花、小檗、鼠李

paragraphs.text: There are many problems associated with invasive species. First of all, these species can take over a garden. Secondly, birds disperse seeds through their waste. Thirdly, humans are the primary cause of the spread of invasive species. Now, let's move on and talk about some examples of invasive species. The first one is common broom, Cytisus scoparius. It comes from Europe and has flowers in the summer. In some regions, its spread has left negative effects on the industry of timber.

Nowadays, biologists are making efforts to manage it with some species of pears. Another example is Japanese barberry, Berberis thunbergi. It is transported from Russia before 1900. It has yellow insects under the bark. The third example is common buckthorn, Rhamnus cathartica. The berries with thorns leaves grow in yellow flower. It is spread widely due to the diet and migration patterns of the robin. More importantly, it has medicinal functions for digestive problems.
